retries.message:
the two ways of counting do not agree. The source says 50,671,499 records went through; the outputs account for 48,024,000. That is 5.2% apart and the limit is 5%. One of them is wrong, so neither can be used.
  The outputs are BEHIND the source, which points at checkpoint phase. The committed offset moves a whole checkpoint at a time; the outputs move continuously, so they trail by up to one interval. Here that interval is 10s against a 60s window -- 17% of it. Shorten checkpointMs or lengthen the window until that ratio is well under the tolerance. Run 45 took its four-core disagreement from 10.5% to 1.19% by halving the interval, changing nothing else.

stepRatios.claimJudgedOn: lower bound of the ratio's interval
